SILHOUETTED MID-DRIFT IN AN ECLIPSE — body a dark diagonal cutout against the corona's ring of light, arms slightly spread, every suit-edge rimmed in cold silver fire.
READING THE FOREARM SLATE — floating at a lazy angle, chin dipped toward the data-slate strapped to the left forearm, the right hand hovering ready to scroll.
